148: 	
149: 	/**
150: 	 * The {@link ResizerFactory} which is used to obtain a {@link Resizer}
151: 	 * for the resizing operation.
152: 	 * <p>
153: 	 * By delaying the decision of picking the {@link Resizer} to use until
154: 	 * when the thumbnail is to be created could lead to a more suitable
155: 	 * {@link Resizer} being picked, as the dimensions for the source and
156: 	 * destination images are known at that time.
157: 	 */
158: 	protected ResizerFactory resizerFactory;
159: 
160: 	/**
161: 	 * Creates and initializes an instance of {@link ThumbnailMaker}.
162: 	 */
163: 	public ThumbnailMaker() {
164: 		ready = new ReadinessTracker();
165: 		ready.unset(PARAM_IMAGE_TYPE);
166: 		ready.unset(PARAM_RESIZER);
167: 		ready.unset(PARAM_RESIZERFACTORY);
168: 		defaultImageType();
169: 		defaultResizerFactory();
170: 	}
171: 	
172: 	/**
173: 	 * Makes a thumbnail.
174: 	 * 
175: 	 * @param img		The source image.
176: 	 * @return			The thumbnail created from the source image, using the
177: 	 * 					parameters set by the {@link ThumbnailMaker}.
178: 	 */
179: 	public abstract BufferedImage make(BufferedImage img);
180: 	
181: 	/**
182: 	 * Makes a thumbnail of the specified dimensions, from the specified
183: 	 * source image.
184: 	 * 
185: 	 * @param img		The source image.
186: 	 * @param width		The target width of the thumbnail.
187: 	 * @param height	The target height of the thumbnail.
188: 	 * @return			The thumbnail image.
189: 	 * @throws IllegalStateException		If the {@code ThumbnailMaker} is
190: 	 * 										not ready to create thumbnails.
191: 	 * @throws IllegalArgumentException		If the width and/or height is less
192: 	 * 										than or equal to zero.
193: 	 */
194: 	protected BufferedImage makeThumbnail(BufferedImage img, int width, int height) {
195: 		if (!ready.isReady()) {
196: 			throw new IllegalStateException(ThumbnailMaker.NOT_READY_FOR_MAKE);
197: 		}
198: 		
199: 		if (width <= 0) {
200: 			throw new IllegalArgumentException(
201: 					"Width must be greater than zero."
202: 			);
203: 		}
204: 		if (height <= 0) {
205: 			throw new IllegalArgumentException(
206: 					"Height must be greater than zero."
207: 			);
208: 		}
209: 
210: 		BufferedImage thumbnailImage =
211: 			new BufferedImageBuilder(width, height, imageType).build();
212: 		
213: 		Dimension imgSize = new Dimension(img.getWidth(), img.getHeight());
214: 		Dimension thumbnailSize = new Dimension(width, height);
215: 		
216: 		Resizer resizer = resizerFactory.getResizer(imgSize, thumbnailSize);
217: 		
218: 		resizer.resize(img, thumbnailImage);
219: 		
220: 		return thumbnailImage;
221: 	}
222: 
223: 	/**
224: 	 * Sets the type for the {@link BufferedImage} to produce.
225: 	 * 
226: 	 * @param imageType		The type of the {@code BufferedImage}.
227: 	 * @return				A reference to this object.
228: 	 */
229: 	public ThumbnailMaker imageType(int imageType) {
230: 		this.imageType = imageType;
231: 		ready.set(PARAM_IMAGE_TYPE);
232: 		return this;
233: 	}
234: 	
235: 	/**
236: 	 * Sets the type of the {@link BufferedImage} to be the default type.
237: 	 * 
238: 	 * @return				A reference to this object.
239: 	 */
240: 	public ThumbnailMaker defaultImageType() {
241: 		return imageType(DEFAULT_IMAGE_TYPE);
242: 	}
243: 	
244: 	/**
245: 	 * Sets the {@link Resizer} which is used for the resizing operation.
246: 	 * 
247: 	 * @param resizer		The {@link Resizer} to use when resizing the image
248: 	 * 						to create the thumbnail.
249: 	 * @return				A reference to this object.
250: 	 */
251: 	public ThumbnailMaker resizer(Resizer resizer) {
252: 		this.resizerFactory = new FixedResizerFactory(resizer);
253: 		ready.set(PARAM_RESIZER);
254: 		ready.set(PARAM_RESIZERFACTORY);
255: 		return this;
256: 	}
257: 	
258: 	/**
259: 	 * Sets the {@link Resizer} to use the default {@link Resizer}.
260: 	 * 
261: 	 * @return				A reference to this object.
262: 	 */
263: 	public ThumbnailMaker defaultResizer() {
264: 		return defaultResizerFactory();
265: 	}
266: 	
267: 	/**
268: 	 * Sets the {@link ResizerFactory} which is used to obtain a {@link Resizer}
269: 	 * for the resizing operation.
270: 	 * 
271: 	 * @param resizerFactory		The {@link ResizerFactory} to obtain the
272: 	 * 						{@link Resizer} used when resizing the image
273: 	 * 						to create the thumbnail.
274: 	 * @return				A reference to this object.
275: 	 * @since	0.4.0
276: 	 */
277: 	public ThumbnailMaker resizerFactory(ResizerFactory resizerFactory) {
278: 		this.resizerFactory = resizerFactory;
279: 		ready.set(PARAM_RESIZER);
280: 		ready.set(PARAM_RESIZERFACTORY);
281: 		return this;
282: 	}
283: 	
284: 	/**
285: 	 * Sets the {@link ResizerFactory} to use {@link DefaultResizerFactory}.
286: 	 * 
287: 	 * @return				A reference to this object.
288: 	 * @since	0.4.0
289: 	 */
290: 	public ThumbnailMaker defaultResizerFactory() {
291: 		this.resizerFactory = DefaultResizerFactory.getInstance();
292: 		ready.set(PARAM_RESIZER);
293: 		ready.set(PARAM_RESIZERFACTORY);
294: 		return this;
295: 	}
296: }
